_about: Starship 是否在 2025-03-31 前实际入轨的冻结证据包。信息截至 2025-01-31；两条资料均在截点前发布。

evidence.title: FAA Statement on SpaceX Starship Flight 7 Mishap
evidence.excerpt: The FAA is requiring SpaceX to perform a mishap investigation into the loss of the Starship vehicle during launch operations on Jan. 16.
evidence.claim: Flight 7 在 2025-01-16 发生飞行器损失并进入事故调查，说明截至截点 Starship 尚未完成稳定的轨道级飞行。

evidence.title: Starship's Seventh Flight Test
evidence.excerpt: On January 16, 2025, Starship successfully lifted off at 4:37 p.m. CT from Starbase in Texas.
evidence.claim: SpaceX 官方记录 Flight 7 实际执行，但该次飞行器随后失联并未形成一次完整轨道运行。
